messages:
Lina R.: Heads-up: tenant 'omega' on dedicated eu-west cluster seeing intermittent 504s + high tail latency on /v1/generate. Customer provided a request id: req_20260317_aa12 and a client timestamp 2026-03-17T15:02:10Z. They say it happens once every few hours.

Ben A.: Thanks Lina. Can you grab the exact curl they used and the model/route? Also which dedicated pool?

Lina R.: curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2-16k","input":"translate: ...","max_tokens":256}' -i
```
Route: POST /v1/generate, model gpt-open-2-16k. Pool: eu-west-2b-dedicated-3.

Priya S.: Oncall here. I'll coordinate log collection. First things to capture: pod stdout/stderr, kube events, node dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshot, and our runtime trace for req_20260317_aa12 if present. Do we have a pod name?

Lina R.: Customer saw a proxy pod id tenant-proxy-omega-1f4 and we observed inference pod inference-omega-4a1bcd in that pool. They reported latency spike around token ~180.

Marco T. (eng-runtime): If spike is mid-token stream, check KV cache metrics and kernel launch patterns. Please pull `runtime_kv_cache_hits` and `runtime_kv_cache_latency_ms` around the timestamp.

infra-bot: Runbook note: use `rdw collect-debug --request req_20260317_aa12 --nodes eu-west-2b-dedicated-3 --include-pods tenant-proxy-omega-1f4,inference-omega-4a1bcd --mask` to build redacted bundle.

Priya S.: Commands I'm running now (for SRE):
```
kubectl -n ded-system logs inference-omega-4a1bcd --all-containers --since=45m > /tmp/inference-omega.log
kubectl -n ded-system get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=inference-omega-4a1bcd > /tmp/inference-events.log
ssh node-eu-west-2b-03 "sudo dmesg --ctime | tail -n 300" > /tmp/node-dmesg.log
ssh node-eu-west-2b-03 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,timestamp,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.used --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu-series.csv" & sleep 6; pkill -f nvidia-smi
cat /var/log/redwood/runtime/trace-req_20260317_aa12.log* > /tmp/runtime-trace.log
```

Lina R.: Asked customer to re-run with X-Request-ID header so we can correlate: `-H "X-Request-ID: req_20260317_aa12-repro1"`. They repro'd once and saw a 2.1s tail latency.

support-bot: Reminder: redact PII before upload: `rdw redact --bundle /tmp/debug-bundle.tar.gz` and then upload to internal bucket.

Marco T. (eng-runtime): Also capture tenant-proxy logs to rule out auth refresh loops: `kubectl -n tenant-proxy logs tenant-proxy-omega-1f4 --since=1h`. If there's a 401->200 refresh, that can add latency.

Priya S.: Collected initial artifacts and pushed to s3://rdw-debug/1867009999/req_20260317_aa12_repro1. Link: https://s3.redwood/rdw-debug/1867009999/req_20260317_aa12_repro1

Ben A.: Good. Can we also pull prometheus windows +/- 5m around event with 15s step for these metrics: `nvidia_gpu_utilization`, `nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes`, `runtime_kv_cache_hits`, and `runtime_kv_cache_latency_ms`?

Priya S.: Done. Query used: `query_range` with start=2026-03-17T14:57:00Z end=2026-03-17T15:07:00Z step=15s. CSVs attached to bundle.

Marco T. (eng-runtime): Quick scan of runtime trace shows a ~1.7s stall during token emission with many tiny kernel launches. Dmesg does not show GPU XID, but node dmesg has a brief NV peer memory warning at the exact time. Need infra to check scheduling and potential GPU migration.

Priya S.: Also collected controller/autoscaler logs: `kubectl -n platform logs deployment/scaler --since=2h > /tmp/scaler.log` in case of placement churn. No scale events in that window.

Lina R.: Customer provided a minimal client-side trace that shows a CPU spike on their proxy at the same time as the latency. Could be tenant-proxy CPU/backpressure.

Ben A.: Priya, can you pull the tenant-proxy pod metrics (cpu/latency) and include the proxy logs? If auth is flipping, we'd see it in proxy logs.

Priya S.: Done: tenant-proxy metrics and logs are in the bundle. No 401s, but there are repeated auth token refreshes every ~50s from their side (they use short-lived tokens). Marco, could repeated auth handshakes cause small stalls that add up?

Marco T. (eng-runtime): It can, especially if the proxy blocks network or stalls token exchange synchronously during generation. But the kernel pattern suggests a short GPU scheduling jitter, so both factors might be compounding.

eng-sre: We're going to create an alert for route /v1/generate with pool=eu-west-2b-dedicated-3 for p95>1.5s. If it recurs >3x/day escalate.

Lina R.: Customer agreed to run two more repros in a quiet window and to attach X-Request-ID headers: req_20260317_aa12-repro2 and req_20260317_aa12-repro3. Please collect fresh bundles each time and redact before sending.

Priya S.: Repro2 completed at 2026-03-17T15:22:40Z, latency 2.3s. Uploaded to s3://rdw-debug/1867009999/req_20260317_aa12_repro2. Redaction applied.

Marco T. (eng-runtime): I'll deep-dive the traces this afternoon. Next triage steps: map kernel launch timestamps to GPU utilization spikes, confirm no GPU resets, and examine whether tenant-proxy synchronous refresh correlates to generation stalls. If we confirm infra scheduling jitter, we will loop in eng-infra.

Priya S.: Noted. Closing the slack thread but keeping ticket SUP-8937 open for follow-ups.

support-bot: Thread archived by Lina R. — attach bundle ids for ticket SUP-8937: 1867009999-req_20260317_aa12_repro1, repro2
